summary: Tested this session's new work: TS compile fix (app loads cleanly, no red screen), hardened admin credentials (no hardcoded fallback in server.py), RevenueCat native-purchase integration + web Test Store paywall, new /about screen for Richa Madan, and premium gating for 2 new games (Scenario Sense, Empathy Challenge). Backend: 29/29 pytest pass (23 existing + 6 new for revenuecat/sync + admin identity). Frontend: full flow verified via Playwright - signup, admin/user login, About screen (photo placeholder, bio, certs, quote, back button all render), Games tab shows 9 games with 2 locked PREMIUM badges for non-premium user, locked card tap -> /paywall redirect works, direct deep-link to /games/empathy-challenge as non-premium also redirects to /paywall, paywall shows Monthly $9.99/Yearly $79.99 package cards + Test Store badge + Restore Purchases button, Subscribe button correctly disabled (aria-disabled=true) for non-premium user due to documented RC web identity limitation (verified no crash). Admin: name shows 'Richa Madan' with Admin badge, can fully play both new games end-to-end (Scenario Sense 8/8 rounds + result + replay; Empathy Challenge 7/7 situations + star rating + replay), admin paywall shows 'You're Premium - Continue'. Spot-checked old game (Mood Match) still works unaffected by games.tsx refactor. Videos tab premium gating (pre-existing) still correctly shows 2 PREMIUM badges for free user.

issues: Pre-existing (not new this session, re-confirmed): 'shadow* style props are deprecated, use boxShadow' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated, use props.resizeMode' console warnings still present on every screen.

action_items: No blocking issues found this session. RevenueCat web-preview identity-binding limitation is already documented as known/expected (Subscribe button correctly disabled, no crash) - do not re-report.

Optional/low-priority cleanup carried over from prior iteration (not re-tested in depth, assumed unchanged): shadow*->boxShadow and Image resizeMode deprecation warnings; bottom tab overlap on some screens; useEffect dependency warnings in calm-breathing.tsx/memory-cards.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback removal confirmed via source scan - no hardcoded 'admin@emoticoach.app'/'Admin@123' literals remain outside .env/tests.
lib/revenuecat.tsx purchaseMutation correctly gates on originalAppUserId prefix check before allowing a purchase - good defense against anonymous-identity purchases leaking through.

app/games/scenario-sense.tsx and empathy-challenge.tsx both correctly guard with useEffect + router.replace('/paywall') for deep-link protection, and return null while locked to avoid flashing game content.
seed_data_creation: Created regular test user testuser_rc_review@example.com / Test@1234 via UI signup (persists in DB, not cleaned up). Pytest created TEST_rc_*@example.com fresh per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL from frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL as the generic instructions mention) - used this correctly in test files. Admin: admin@emoticoach.app/Admin@123 -> name 'Richa Madan', premium=true, role=admin. Test user testuser_rc_review@example.com/Test@1234 is non-premium. Tab bar has no testIDs (used get_by_text('Kids')/('Videos') for navigation); tab bar is only present inside (tabs) group screens, not on /games/* or /about sub-routes (expected, not a bug). Browser session/localStorage does not persist across separate browser_automation tool calls, so each script needs its own login.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found requiring RCA in this session's new work. All features matched the problem statement exactly, including the deliberately-disabled Subscribe button in web preview (confirmed working as designed, not a defect).
